extracted.name: Kid-Pleasing Sloppy Joes
extracted.description: These kid-friendly Sloppy Joes are an American treasure. The sauce in this version has ketchup as a base, with cider vinegar, brown sugar, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce.
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef and onion in the hot skillet until beef is completely browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Return skillet to the heat.
Stir ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and mustard into the beef mixture; simmer, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is thick, 15 to 20 minutes.
